title: Epstein-Barr virus nuclear antigen proteins deploy diverse mechanisms to bind the human genome
authors: Haque MR; Tushar AR; Park M; Moon CI; Rahman MS; Samee MAH
one_liner_zh: 该文用CNN分析EB病毒转录因子EBNA2/3的ChIP-seq数据，研究其结合人基因组的细胞类型特异与通用机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作但缺乏三维结构建模与动态机理，方法为AI但深度有限。
abstract: Viral transcription factors (vTFs) are known to bind the human genome and impact critical biological processes. However, a vTF can infect multiple cell-types, and the extent to which they deploy the same mechanisms for DNA binding across different cell-types is poorly understood. We used the Epstein-Barr virus Nuclear Antigen Proteins 2 and 3 (EBNA2 and EBNA3) to address this gap, the two widely studied vTFs associated with cancers, as case studies. We analyze multiple ChIP-seq datasets of these vTFs from different human cell-lines using a state-of-the-art convolutional neural network model. We show that each vTF uses both cell-type specific and cell-type independent cofactors to bind the human genome. Interestingly, each vTF requires ∼10 cofactors consistently across all binding peaks. Such dependency on a large number of cofactors is in contrast to human TFs since human TFs typically co-bind with 2-3 cofactors. Our de novo motif finding approach also reveals novel sequence motifs at the ChIP peaks of these vTFs. These critical signals were missed by previous studies doing enrichment analysis using known human TFs. Finally, we find that although a vTF impacts similar biological processes across cell-types, it also impacts distinct biological processes in a cell-type specific manner. Our study provides a roadmap for integrative analysis of vTF binding and pinpointing their diverse mechanisms of targeting the human genome across different human cell-types.
abstract_zh: 已知病毒转录因子（vTFs）能结合人类基因组并影响关键生物过程。然而，一种vTF可感染多种细胞类型，而它们在不同细胞类型间是否采用相同机制进行DNA结合，目前了解甚少。我们以Epstein-Barr病毒核抗原蛋白2和3（EBNA2和EBNA3）为案例研究，这两种广泛研究的与癌症相关的vTFs，来填补这一空白。我们使用最先进的卷积神经网络模型，分析了这些vTFs在不同人类细胞系中的多个ChIP-seq数据集。我们表明，每种vTF利用细胞类型特异性和细胞类型非依赖性的辅助因子来结合人类基因组。有趣的是，每种vTF在所有结合峰中一致需要约10个辅助因子。这种对大量辅助因子的依赖与人类转录因子形成对比，因为人类转录因子通常与2-3个辅助因子共结合。我们的从头基序发现方法还揭示了这些vTFs的ChIP峰处的新序列基序。这些关键信号在以往使用已知人类转录因子进行富集分析的研究中被遗漏。最后，我们发现，尽管一种vTF在不同细胞类型中影响相似的生物过程，但它也以细胞类型特异性的方式影响不同的生物过程。我们的研究为vTF结合的综合分析及其在不同人类细胞类型中靶向人类基因组的多样化机制提供了路线图。
